title: Cdiscount Product Scraper
description: Extract product listings from Cdiscount search pages. Provide a Cdiscount search URL or a keyword.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Cdiscount search URL to scrape. Takes precedence over Keyword when supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword used only when Start URL is empty. Ignored when Start URL is supplied.

results_wanted.title: Maximum number of products
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum number of pages
max_pages.description: Safety cap for number of search pages to process.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored products
includeSponsored.description: Include sponsored brand offers when available.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. No proxy is used by default.
